@pastequo: This pull request explicitly references no jira issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/assisted-installer-agent/pull/1401):

>This PR is about preparing a second PR to add more parameter for the `inventory` command.
>
>- Inventory args are isolated to avoid impacting other subprocesses
>- flag.Parse is no longer called several times. AFAIU it is not supported to do it
>```golang
>// Parse parses the command-line flags from [os.Args][1:]. Must be called
>// after all flags are defined and before flags are accessed by the program.
>```
>
>I believe it would be best to refactor using a framework like [cobra](https://github.com/spf13/cobra), but that would have probably way more impact


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Fassisted-installer-agent).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

## Walkthrough Centralizes CLI flag registration by moving dry-run and logging flag registration into config package functions, replaces ProcessDryRunArgs with RegisterDryRunArgs, adds InventoryConfig and ProcessInventoryConfigArgs, and updates callers and inventory APIs to use InventoryConfig instead of SubprocessConfig. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Config core changes**
`src/config/dry_run_config.go`, `src/config/subprocess_config.go`, `src/config/agent_config.go`, `src/config/logs_sender_config.go`, `src/config/logs_sender_config.go`|Replaced `ProcessDryRunArgs`/`DefaultDryRunConfig` with `RegisterDryRunArgs(dryRunConfig *DryRunConfig) error`. Added `RegisterLoggingArgs(loggingConfig *LoggingConfig)`. Changed `ProcessSubprocessArgs()` to no-arg signature and removed `DefaultLoggingConfig`. `ProcessArgs()` now registers dry-run and logging flags earlier and fatals on registration error.| |**New inventory config & args**
`src/config/inventory_config.go`|Added `InventoryConfig` (embeds `DryRunConfig`, `LoggingConfig`, adds `GPUConfigFile`) and `ProcessInventoryConfigArgs()` for inventory-specific CLI registration, parsing, and help handling.| |**Main functions — dry-run/logging wiring moved**
`src/agent/main/main.go`, `src/next_step_runner/main.go`, `src/logs_sender/main.go`, `src/apivip_check/main/main.go`, `src/connectivity_check/main/main.go`, `src/dhcp_lease_allocate/main/main.go`, `src/disk_speed_check/main.go`, `src/free_addresses/main.go`, `src/ntp_synchronizer/main/main.go`|Removed explicit `config.ProcessDryRunArgs(...)` calls from many mains and updated them to obtain configs from the revised `Process*Args()` functions (e.g., `ProcessSubprocessArgs()` or `ProcessInventoryConfigArgs()`); logging setup remains but dry-run registration is now handled by config package functions.| |**Subprocess CLI and logging defaults**
`src/config/subprocess_config.go`|Removed `GPUConfigFile` from `SubprocessConfig` and removed public `DefaultLoggingConfig`. Introduced `RegisterLoggingArgs` which registers logging flags with fixed defaults; `ProcessSubprocessArgs()` now registers logging and dry-run args before parsing flags.| |**Container/domain CLI simplifications**
`src/container_image_availability/main/main.go`, `src/domain_resolution/main/main.go`|Eliminated small per-command `Config` types and helper functions; moved `-request` flag to package-level variable and inlined parsing/validation in `main()`.| |**Logs sender dry-run wiring**
`src/logs_sender/main.go`, `src/config/logs_sender_config.go`|Removed direct call to `ProcessDryRunArgs` from `Main()`; `ProcessLogsSenderConfigArgs` now calls `RegisterDryRunArgs` and fatals on error before flag parsing.| |**Inventory package API & tests updated**
`src/inventory/...`
`src/inventory/bmc.go`, `src/inventory/disks.go`, `src/inventory/gpu.go`, `src/inventory/dry_inventory.go`, `src/inventory/inventory.go`, `src/inventory/main.go`, `src/inventory/bmc_test.go`, `src/inventory/disks_test.go`, `src/inventory/gpu_test.go`|Replaced uses of `*config.SubprocessConfig` with `*config.InventoryConfig` across inventory code and tests. Updated struct fields, constructors, and function signatures (e.g., `GetBmcAddress`, `GetBmcV6Address`, `GetDisks`, `GetGPUs`, `ReadInventory`, `CreateInventoryInfo`). Dry-run override fields now read from `InventoryConfig`.| |**Tests updated to new config type**
`src/inventory/*_test.go`|Test fixtures and assertions updated to instantiate and pass `*config.InventoryConfig` where `*config.SubprocessConfig` was previously used; behavior and expectations unchanged.| |**Misc mains updated**
`src/apivip_check/main/main.go`, `src/connectivity_check/main/main.go`, `src/dhcp_lease_allocate/main/main.go`, `src/disk_speed_check/main.go`, `src/free_addresses/main.go`, `src/ntp_synchronizer/main/main.go`|Switched calls to `config.ProcessSubprocessArgs()` to the new no-arg signature and removed subsequent `ProcessDryRunArgs(...)` invocations in those mains.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~40 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 8 | ❌ 2 ### ❌ Failed checks (2 warnings) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :------------------------: | :--------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 17.86% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | Test files lack meaningful failure messages in assertions, violating Ginkgo requirements for diagnostic context. | Add descriptive failure messages to all assertion calls, such as 'Expect(err).NotTo(HaveOccurred(), "failed to create temporary GPU config file")'. |
✅ Passed checks (8 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title directly and accurately describes the main refactoring objective: consolidating flag parsing to avoid multiple calls to flag.Parse() across different configuration registration functions. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | Pull request does not introduce dynamic test names in Ginkgo tests; all test titles in modified files remain stable and deterministic using static descriptive strings. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR is for the openshift/assisted-installer-agent repository, a Go utility/agent package, not an e2e test repository. It refactors flag parsing and configuration handling, and while it modifies some unit tests, these are not new Ginkgo e2e tests with MicroShift compatibility concerns. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR modifies existing Ginkgo unit tests but does not add new Ginkgo e2e tests, so the check does not apply. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR refactors command-line flag parsing in host-based CLI tools; does not introduce Kubernetes manifests, operators, controllers, or pod scheduling constraints. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The PR improves OTE stdout contract compliance by replacing ProcessDryRunArgs with RegisterDryRunArgs, which returns errors to callers using logrus instead of writing to stdout. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests; only existing unit tests were refactored to update parameter passing. |
